subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: Mother Teresa was one of the noble figures in the world who sacrificed her entire life for the welfare of mankind irrespective of their caste, creed and religion. She was a Christian nun who spent her life to save the dying people of the street of India. From her early age she decided to lead a religious life to do the work of God. After getting permission from the Pope of Rome she started to spread her humanitarian works all over the world with her fellow nuns. She is one of the Nobel peace-winning female figures in the world.
